title: Amours amours amours (Japart)
desc: Jean Japart, Amours amours amours. 4 voices (Discantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jap3001); encoded by Jesse Rodin.
